# @tansy/payments-polar

Polar for @tansy/payments, through better-auth's Polar plugin.

```bash
npm install @tansy/payments-polar
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the payments plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/payments.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
